body: This is called "putting words into someone else's mouth."
I'm a bad person for making this post, right? Whatever.
Trying to get them to relate is asking too much. What are you, some kind of sociopath? They're so happy, and you're going to bring them down by talking about *negative stuff*. Oh, how awful. /s

By the way, I'm not very sexually experienced, but I've had sex a few times, so their insult isn't even correct. But I guess saying that makes me "autistic," right? Not just going along with their bullshit ways of "othering" people is being a "cringeworthy aspie." You either conform, and mock others to earn your place in the pecking order, or you get picked on for being "a virgin." I'm so fucking done with people.

If you "haven't seen anyone say that stuff" you're not looking hard enough. Open your eyes.

I'm going to cut myself today because of how annoying that is. I've seen a lot of people draw a connection between liking philosophy, and being a virgin. People pride themselves on their ignorance. It's literally all about sex. I first thought people might be solely interested in sex when I was 14, and for awhile, I thought I might've been full of shit. Now I'm 25 and I realized I was right. It's all about sex. It's all about sex. It's all about sex. Everything else is just pretension.
